summary: Layer 1B expansion found a small set of US-listed software names with plausible second-order exposure to AI workload sprawl through identity governance, AI/cloud exposure management, observability, and incident/workflow automation. Reference anchors for this node include high-attention observability/security platforms such as Dynatrace, Datadog, Palo Alto Networks/CyberArk, and hyperscaler security stacks, but the discovery lane should prioritize smaller public vendors whose products sit in control-plane, posture-management, or operational-resilience workflows rather than visible AI applications. The strongest underfollowed candidates for later verification are SailPoint, Tenable, and PagerDuty; Varonis remains a near-miss for the next pass focused specifically on data security/DSPM.
